```yaml
name: SCCache Warmup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  warmup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Install sccache
        run: |
          curl -LO https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/releases/download/v1.3.0/sccache-v1.3.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
          tar xzf sccache-v1.3.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
          sudo mv sccache /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Configure sccache
        run: |
          export SCCACHE_DIR=/tmp/sccache
          mkdir -p $SCCACHE_DIR
          sccache --init --server-addr=gs://walrus-sccache

      - name: Build debug
        run: |
          cargo build --workspace --features "walrus-service/backup"
          sccache --show-stats

      - name: Build release
        run: |
          cargo build --release
          sccache --show-stats

      - name: Notify on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "::group::Failure Notification"
          echo "SCCache warmup failed. Please check the logs."
          echo "::endgroup::"

  enable_sccache:
    needs: warmup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Apply SCCache configuration
        run: |
          echo "export SCCACHE_DIR=/tmp/sccache" >> $HOME/.bashrc
          echo "export SCCACHE_READ_ONLY=true" >> $HOME/.bashrc
          source $HOME/.bashrc

      - name: Attach binaries to release
        if: github.ref == 'refs/tags/*'
        uses: ./.github/actions/attach-binaries-to-release
        env:
          GCP_WALRUS_RELEASE_BUCKET_SVCUSER_CREDENTIALS: ${{ secrets.GCP_WALRUS_RELEASE_BUCKET_SVCUSER_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Run code lint job
        if: !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
        uses: ./.github/actions/code
        with:
          job: lint
          features: clippy,cargo_doc

      - name: Run code build job
        if: !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
        uses: ./.github/actions/code
        with:
          job: build
          features: walrus_service_backup
```
